newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson says wins Russian mobile order.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson says wins Russian mobile order.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group LM Ericsson AB on Thursday said it won another mobile phone order in Russia from operator VimpelCom worth 237 million crowns.
Ericsson said the order to expand the D-AMPS/AMPS digital network was the biggest order so far for this system in Russia.
"The order, which is the seventh increase in the network in the Moscow region, will mean better radio contract for a number of suburbs," Ericsson said in a statement.
VimpelCom, which sells its services under the mark Bee-Line, is the biggest mobile phone operator in Russia and the CIS, the statement said.
Ericsson said the expansion should be completed by July 1997 and VimpelCom and Bee-Line would then have about 120,000 subscribers.
